blockers.message: STOP per task brief: cannot implement until reviewer clarifies three contract/design mismatches. (2) Brief says align dashboard_recipe.schema.json version/previousVersionId/status, but frozen v1 dashboard_recipe.schema.json only has version and no previousVersionId/status; canonical v2 dashboard_recipe_v2.schema.json has previous_version/status, not previousVersionId. (3) Brief cites §17.5 rollback endpoint; merged OpenAPI v1.1 has POST /bff/agora/dashboard-recipes/{recipe_id}/rollback with expected_version/target_version/If-Match/Idempotency-Key, but no §17.5 anchor. Need reviewer to confirm the exact authoritative section/file and field spelling before UI implementation.
